*F-OPRF* (Oblivious PRF) is part of *Oblivious Transfer and Correlated Randomness* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Jarecki, Kiayias, and Krawczyk. [*Round-optimal password-protected secret sharing and T-PAKE in the password-only model*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2014/650). In Advances in Cryptology – ASIACRYPT 2014, 2014.
